description:
We have buildings across the country, each equipped with a small sensor device that monitors temperature, and humidity. These devices periodically send us readings via an HTTP integration.
We need a way to automatically flag when something seems wrong. For example:
•  If a device hasn’t been heard from in a while, we want to know.
•  If the conditions it’s reporting seem out of the normal range, we want to know
•  If a device seems to be reporting less frequently than it should, we also want to know. 
Build something that takes in a device’s recent activity and tells us which of these problems, if any, are occurring. We should be able to configure what “normal” looks like.

Our app should provide an easy way to look for devices with specific failures, and check the status of each device. 


Sample Payload

{
"fCnt": 100,
"devEUI": "abcdabcdabcdabcd",
"data": "AQ==",
"object":{"temperature": 50.5 ,"humidity": 75.0},
 "rxInfo": [
{"gatewayID": "1234123412341234",
"name": "G1","time": "2022-07-19T11:00:00",
"rssi": -57,"loRaSNR": 10}
],
   "txInfo": {"frequency": 86810000,"dr": 5}
}
title: Expanded functionality
